name: Licensed gaming payout → Ontario
sub: An MGA-licensed operator pays a player in Toronto; the router picks the partner.

source.description: operator payout file · player winnings from the operator's pre-funded CAD balance (Nium virtual account)

narratives.APPROVED: Two partners were skipped without ever seeing the flow. Eighty-five basis points where the operator pays 3% today — and a rolling reserve that makes the partner whole if the operator doesn't.
narratives.JURISDICTION_OUT_OF_APPETITE: No partner carries private-operator gaming payouts to this province. Nothing touched the core network.
narratives.MARKET_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED: Ontario payouts require the operator to be registered with iGaming Ontario.
narratives.TICKET_ABOVE_MAX: Partner C accepts the operator and the province but caps tickets at CAD 25,000. The policy holds the payout, opens an enhanced-due-diligence case with the operator's source-of-funds pack, and offers a split into two payouts on consecutive days.

options.label: MGA only — not registered in Ontario
